text:
Ben Sales: Passing a low-touch trial to CS — account: Orion Lite (trial tenant: orion-lite). Renewal window ~45d, currently using hosted API, no SSO yet. Deck + quick notes: https://drive.redwood/orion-lite-deck. Need owners for: provisioning, basic enablement (1-2 async checks), and support coverage. Any quick risks?

Aisha CS: @Ben Sales thanks — I can own the enablement + renewal nudges.
- Plan: 1) provisioning ticket -> Support 2) 15m async welcome + sample prompts 3) 30d check-in (low-touch).
- Risk: medium (no SSO + finance might stall at renewal).

Devon Support: taking provisioning. Ticket created: SUP-4723. ETA to complete: EOD tomorrow.
Can you drop test creds and sample dataset here? Also need the tenant org id.

Ben Sales: org id is orion-042. Test creds in the deck (bottom). Dataset = small-customer-sample.csv (5 rows).

Devon Support: got it. I'll run the quick provision script:
```
POST /internal/provision
{
  "tenant":"orion-lite",
  "org_id":"orion-042",
  "tier":"trial",
  "region":"us-west-2"
}
```
Will paste logs here when done.

Jia Eng: I'll standby for any infra follow-ups. If they hit latency or KV-cache issues at demo scale, ping me. For cost/latency tradeoffs we should serve on model variant `redwood/gpt-lite-quant` for the trial. What's expected QPS?

Aisha CS: expected peak ~2rps, avg 0.2rps. Demo flows are short (<= 150 tokens). Keep defaults but Jia if you see anything odd please advise.

Devon Support: provision complete ✅. Endpoint: https://orion-lite.api.redwood/v1. Created API key `rk_live_orion_XXXXX` (masked). Smoke tests passed: sample prompts returned valid completions. Logs: `provision OK — SUP-4723`

Jia Eng: quick note: set autoscale min to 0.5 GPU-equivalent for smoother cold starts on burst. I can push a config if you want.

Aisha CS: please do Jia — that will reduce demo flakiness. Also I'll record a 10m walkthrough and share a short checklist for the customer (API usage, prompt examples, where to find logs).

Ben Sales: thanks all. I'll schedule the kickoff call for Tuesday 10am PT and invite Aisha + Devon + their PM. :calendar:

OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: kickoff call on 2025-03-11T10:00:00-07:00 for thread 1801112222.

Aisha CS: next steps (owners):
- Devon: provisioning & support handover (SUP-4723) — done
- Jia: autoscale config + monitor alert thresholds — action
- Aisha: send walkthrough + 30d check-in cadence + renewal watch
- Ben: customer invite + billing contact

Ben Sales: confirmed. Marking renewal risk = "monitor"; will escalate if finance asks for SSO before renewal.

Devon Support: closing SUP-4723 reference in ticket. Will reopen if anything pops in smoke tests.

Aisha CS: captured feedback: customer asked for a short demo recording, clearer sample prompts, and an SSO timeline. I'll capture in C360 notes after the kickoff.

Ben Sales: appreciated. :thumbsup:

Jia Eng: I'll drop the autoscale patch by EOD and add a lightweight latency dashboard (per-route).

Aisha CS: perfect. I'll follow up after the kickoff with a one-pager and assign renewal owner in 30d.

Ben Sales: closing the pass — thanks everyone.
